semantics.clock: External arrival to host engine-return output/completion; no client acknowledgement.
semantics.cohort: All external requests, including failed and unfinished; missing cells retained.
semantics.incomplete_flow: Legacy max(timeout_s, observation_end_s-arrival_s) penalty, separately from completed flow.
semantics.gap: Per-request maximum interval between distinct host output timestamps; TTFT is separate.
semantics.frontier: Inherited fixed development diagnostic frontier, NOT application SLO or a selected main threshold.
semantics.causality: Different input cases are separate workload characterizations; no cross-cell policy or causal comparison.
semantics.work: Natural output lengths/sequences and recovery counts can differ; rate is NOT equal-work speedup.
semantics.repeats: One run per input case (repeats=1). Events are dependent observations, not independent repetitions.
semantics.cost: Successful-selector time from the common analyzer; observation and boundary-probe timing are retained separately when recorded. No complete-controller-cost claim.
semantics.episodes: Observed target/victim intervals and subsequent events are absolute outcomes, not incremental victim harm.
semantics.shadow: Read-only rankings of the recorded legal candidates. Changed shadow choices are opportunities, not executed interventions or measured gains.
semantics.host_signal: Materialized whole pages after the ready contiguous host prefix; not actual absent-key count, bytes to save, or measured recomputation time.
semantics.unknown: A shadow rule is UNKNOWN if any required candidate signal is missing/nonfinite; unknown values are never filled with zero.
semantics.pressure: Recorded schedule-boundary extrema, not continuous physical peaks. Pending transfer jobs are metadata, not device completion.
semantics.host_size: Compare host ranking with minimum floor(computed_tokens/16) and minimum held_blocks, using the same latest-running-index tie-break. Equal-size signal variation is observational evidence of a distinct signal, not causal benefit.

configuration.arrivals: Unique existing natural articles, input-length-stratified nested sets, external 0.01s intervals

configuration.cache: initially empty private compilation cache each cell

plan.primary: Descriptive characterization of all-request external-arrival flow, TTFT, max generation gaps, throughput, failures/incompletion and actual pressure/action diversity. One run per load; no policy benefit claim.
plan.slo: No application SLO. Inherited20point frontier is diagnostic only.
plan.hypothesis: Normal PRO6000 capacity with richer in-flight requests may expose diverse legal victims and costs; pressure labels are intended loads, not proof of actual pressure.
plan.claim_ceiling: Native serving descriptive operating-regime evidence; not a victim-policy comparison, independent repeats or same-state causal replay. No fabricated application SLO or equal-work speedup.
plan.retention: Retain all failures and raw outputs; one frozen package; no in-group code changes; whole-group common lock; nonblocking no queued retry.

source.selection: Sort all 384 unique requests by (prompt length, request_id); partition into 64 consecutive rank strata of six. Interleave one item from each stratum per 64-request phase, visiting strata in six-bit-reversed order. Within even strata use rank order [1,4,0,5,2,3], within odd strata [4,1,5,0,3,2]. Thus prefixes 128,256,320 take exactly 2,4,5 requests from every stratum. Only prompt lengths and stable identities determine selection and order.
First128 source-ordered complete articles after quarantining prior train prefix ending row21131 and excluding known local identities/text/token content; full token length256..3072. No outcomes used.
